data.name: Ayyubun
data.gender_notes: Ayyubun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the name of Prophet Job in the Quran. The name Ayyubun carries the meaning “Job's Son” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayyubun usually hope their child will grow to embody job's son and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are spiritually tested and purified
data.etymology: Ayyubun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Job's Son.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayyubun total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أَيُّوبون
in_arabic.meaning: أَيُّوبون: مُؤَنَّث أَيُّوب، تَجَديد، مُقاوَمَة، وَإِفتِخارٌ بِالعزّ
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَيُّوبون: اسْمٌ مُؤَنَّثٌ مِنهُ أَيُّوب، وَهُوَ مُشتَقٌ مِنْ أَيُّوبَ وَهِيَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الرَسُولِ صَلَى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَمَ، وَهُوَ مَنَحَ الْعَزِزُ بِالغَلَبَةِ، وَبِالتَفَوُّقِ، وَبِالعِزِّ، وَالتَبَعُذِ، وَالتَصَدُيقِ، وَالتَعَفُّفِ، وَهُوَ اسْمٌ مُقَوَّمٌ وَمُقاوِمٌ، وَمُتَفَوّقٌ، وَمُتَصَدّقٌ، وَمُتَعَفّقٌ، وَبِهِ يُعزّي اللَهُ مَنِ اِستَعَناهُ، وَيُذَكّي مَنِ اِستَعَناهُ، وَإِنَّهُ مُفتَحٌ عَلَيهِ مِنَ العَزّ، وَمِنَ التَعَفُّفِ، وَالتَصَدُيقِ

in_urdu.name: ایوبون
in_urdu.meaning: ایوبون: ایوب کا مؤنث، تازگی، مزاحمت، اور عظمت کی خوشی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایوبون: ایوب نام کا مؤنث روپ، جو ایوب نام سے ماخوذ ہے اور ایوب ایک صحابی ہیں جن کو اللہ تعالیٰ نے غلبہ اور عزت عطا کی، اس نام کے ساتھ ساتھ اس کے معانی ہیں تازگی، مزاحمت، عظمت کی خوشی، اور ہمیشہ عظمت والوں کی طرح کھٹھا، ہمدرد، اور محتلف ہونا

in_hindi.name: अय्यूबुन
in_hindi.meaning: अय्यूबुन: अय्यूब का मादा, नवीनता, प्रतिरोध, और गौरव
in_hindi.long_meaning: अय्यूबुन: अय्यूब नाम का मादा रूप, जो अय्यूब नाम से मिलता है, जो एक सहाबी है जिसे अल्लाह ने कीर्ति और गौरव दिया था, इसी नाम के साथ यह भी है नवीनता, प्रतिरोध, गौरव की खुशी, और हमेशा गौरवशाली लोगों की तरह तेज़, मित्रवत, और अलग-थलग

in_pashto.name: ایوبون
in_pashto.meaning: ایوبون: دایوب په مؤنثه، نويښت، جنجال، او دېږنې
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایوبون: دایوب نوم د مؤنث په څیر، چی دایوب څخه اخیستل شوی، دایوب یو صحابي دی چی الله تعالی نې غلبه او عزت ورکړی، داینوم شاوخړای دغه سره سره یې دغه معانی لري، نويښت، جنجال، دېږنې او د عزت والو په څير، دېږنه، ښه ملگری، او څرګند

in_english.name: Ayyubun
in_english.meaning: Ayyubun: Female form of Ayyub, newness, resistance, and pride
in_english.long_meaning: Ayyubun: The feminine form of the name Ayyub, derived from Ayyub, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, to whom Allah granted victory and pride. With this name, it also conveys newness, resistance, and the joy of pride, and is associated with the traits of the proud, such as being quick, friendly, and different. In Islamic tradition, Ayyub is celebrated as a model of patience and perseverance in the face of adversity, and his name is often given to children born into families that value these qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ayyubun" (or "Ayoub") is one of the most widely recognized Islamic names, originating from the story of Prophet Job (Ayub) in the Quran. This name has been embraced across various Islamic communities worldwide, symbolizing endurance, steadfastness, and patience in times of adversity. The Prophet Job is renowned for his unwavering faith and courage during trials, which has left a significant mark on Islamic and Arabic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Ayyubun is a reminder of the Prophet Job and his unwavering faith in Allah during trials and tribulations. The name inspires individuals to stay steadfast in their faith, drawing strength from the life story of Prophet Job. It encourages patience, resilience, and self-righteousness - qualities that have been important to many individuals throughout history seeking to better themselves spiritually. In Islamic tradition, bearing the name of such revered and noble figures is believed to have a direct impact on one's character and demeanor. Thus, the spiritual significance of Ayyubun extends beyond just being an Islamic name but serves as an inspiration for leading a life that embodies the virtues of the Prophet Job.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ayyubun signifies the endurance and patience of Job (Ayyub in Arabic) in the face of adversity. It is a reminder of his unwavering faith and reliance on Allah during times of hardship.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ayyubid Dynasty, founded by Salah ad-Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub in 1171 CE during the Crusades. The name Ayyubun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Salah ad-Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub, known as Saladin, rose to power after the fall of Egypt to the Crusaders and united the Muslim world under his rule, establishing the Ayyubid Dynasty.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Sultan Ayyub, son of Salah ad-Din, ruled as the fourth Ayyubid Sultan from 1218 to 1240 CE. The name Ayyubun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Sultan Ayyub, also known as Ayyub ibn Al-Adil, succeeded his father Salah ad-Din and continued his military campaigns against the Crusaders, extending the Ayyubid Empire to its greatest territorial extent.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Ayyubun' in modern context refers to the Prophet Job (Ayyub in Arabic) from the Islamic tradition. His story is widely known for his unwavering faith and patience during numerous trials and tribulations. In contemporary discourse, his name is often invoked to highlight compassionate leadership and humanitarian efforts. Job's story is taught in Islamic history blogs, Arabic literature, and is a popular topic on Muslim social media.
